stem: Which escalation package is most useful when Technician II identifies a cultivation-equipment fault?
choices: The asset name and a note saying broken
Asset/zone, time, observed symptom, command/state/output evidence, permitted checks already performed, affected crop/process scope, and unresolved risk
A guess about which internal component failed
Only a screenshot of the controller dashboard
rationale: A maintenance-ready escalation preserves traceable evidence and scope without overstating an unverified root cause or crossing into unauthorized repair.
